name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for @mstar-harness/dsh. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type surface (CommandDefinition / CommandInvocation / CommandResult / CommandDescriptor / ParsedCommand, parseCommand) and just enough runtime for real-composition tests (name normalization, fiber-scoped registry, handler execution via parseCommand). Mirrors dsh-private commit 9451be2 (2026-08-07 snapshot).
